correctness.rationale: From the exact binary seam-flip and swap generator, sector parity preservation and connectivity give uniform stationary laws. The two-point instantaneous spin covariance is the identity for \(L\ge3\). The generator intertwines the coordinate spin subspace with the antiperiodic L-site Laplacian, whose Fourier eigenvalues are strictly negative. Reflected half-cycle equations have irreducible Metzler matrices and imply strict sign for every \(t>0\), with exact antipodal cancellation at even L. Explicit Green inversion yields \((L-2|i-j|)/4\), and summation yields \(L(L^2+2)/12\). The complete Markov generator checker verifies the separate finite \(3\le L\le8\) examples in both sectors. The infinite statement follows analytically, not by extrapolation.

Direct inspection of its Sections 3, 4 and 7 shows no all-t sign wall, integrated signed Green function, or exact magnetization correlation time. value.rationale: The source motivates finite-time dynamics beyond its stationary-sector census. This theorem characterizes all stationary pairwise temporal spin signs at every distance, time and system size, exhibits an exact antipodal cancellation and both positive/negative temporal correlations despite zero static pairwise correlation, and yields the complete linear Green function and quadratic total-spin integrated-memory law. These are natural structural dynamical observables of a recently introduced interacting process; they are not an arbitrary finite enumeration or restatement of generic Fourier diagonalization.
